title: Explore More, Validate Less: Efficient Reflective Prompt Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.27367v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reflective prompt optimization improves instructions using task feedback, but coupling candidate generation with full-validation-based selection can make search costly and sequential. We propose a two-stage framework that decouples reflective candidate-pool construction from validation allocation. During construction, we sample multiple parents and reuse each parent's training responses across parallel reflection branches. Each revision is screened against its parent on a small training minibatch, allowing locally improved candidates to support further revisions without full validation. After construction, an exploration policy selects candidates from the frozen pool under a fixed full-validation budget, and the prompt with the highest measured validation score is returned. This separation allows candidate-pool size and validation budget to be set independently. We evaluate random selection and learned score prediction with similarity-ba

translated_title: 更多探索，更少验证：高效的反思式提示优化
translated_abstract: 反思式提示优化利用任务反馈来改进指令，但将候选生成与基于完整验证的选择耦合在一起，会使搜索过程代价高昂且只能顺序进行。我们提出了一个两阶段框架，将反思式候选池的构建与验证资源的分配解耦。在构建阶段，我们采样多个父提示，并在并行的反思分支中复用每个父提示的训练响应。每个修订版本在小型训练小批量数据上与其父提示进行筛选比较，使得局部改进的候选无需完整验证即可支持进一步的修订。构建完成后，探索策略在固定的完整验证预算下从冻结的候选池中选择候选，并返回测得验证分数最高的提示。这种解耦使得候选池大小和验证预算可以独立设置。我们评估了随机选择以及基于相似度的学习分数预测方法……
tldr: 提出了一种两阶段框架，将反思式候选池的构建与完整验证的分配解耦，使候选池规模和验证预算可以独立设置，从而大幅提升提示优化的效率。
en_tdlr: A two-stage framework decouples reflective candidate-pool construction from full-validation allocation, enabling efficient prompt optimization with independently scalable pool size and validation budget.
